limitations: Support alignment is checked against existing member projections; connection contact and engineering remain NOT_YET_RUN.
Perimeter terminations are not claimed to be verified supports.
Parallel strip recipes use real board widths; boards within a strip share width and may differ in thickness and source.
Internal support-end band seams use the existing research gap; no new supports are created.
Structural and first-pass residuals are explicit interval-tracked OFFCUT supply; frozen assignments are unchanged.
Edge rips are modeled fabrication operations, not confirmation that a saw operation has physically occurred.
